text: Fugitive Lake Swamp: Area 3
Gemma
Anono
Pelulu
Muti
Elder Rana
Cannot go to another map during the battle!
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Gemma!!
Aye~, Coenubia!\nApparently they're here too...\nThat thing?! Look, over there!!
The Coenubias are keeping their distance from the\nwater...They seem to have learned about their own\nweakness...
My goshhh!!
Although getting weaker, it seems that they still\nhave the strength to fight. As you aren't near the\nwater, Anono can't use water attack either...
An unusual crystal is left behind.\nIt appears to contain liquid inside.
The Coenubias in the world you come from never\nleft anything like this behind...Perhaps it is\ndangerous, let's just leave it there...
Aye?!\nHey, hey, look.\nThere's something...
Hey, Ranas!\nPlease show yourselves if you can hear me!
Hmph...So you won't show yourselves, that's fine!\nI've got an idea...
Pelulu, what are you doing?
Huh? As you can see. I'm going to use the fish\nI caught as bait to fish out a Rana.
What? That's way too extreme...
Yaaassss!!
Oooh?!
Oh my gosh?!
I don't think you're trying to harm my child...
I apologize for what we suddenly did to your child\nearlier. We're not here to fight you.\nWill you please listen to what we have to say?
I'm sorry! I only did it to make you come out!
...Okay.\nWhat is it?
Muti told him that you want the Eumanos and the\nRanas to work together to defeat Coenubias and\nyou want to discuss it with their leader...
...So we would like to meet your leader...
I got what you mean...But, we're just a small\ngroup of Ranas who left our country to live here.\nI'm sorry, but we don't have a leader here...
So, where can we find the leader?
Most Ranas live in [FFFF64]Aquacity[FFFFFF], a place that is far\nfrom this Movere Silva. It's extremely difficult\nto go there as there's no land connected to it.
I see. So it's not connected to this place.
But don't worry!\nWe've got a special means of transport!
Oh...really?\nAlright, just a moment...
Take this with you.
You received [FFFF64]Rana's Bangle[FFFFFF] from Elder Rana!
Whoa! This is amazing!\nThere are so many beautiful stones that I've never\nseen before. Moreover...
Wow! Isn't this a pearl?!\nSeems like it will sell for a lot of money...
?! E-err, I...I...I'm not gonna do that tho.\nH-haha, hahaha...By the way, what is this?
It's a symbol of trust made with rare stones and\ngemstones for those who will not harm the Ranas...\nJust show it to the Ranas in Aquacity...
I'm sorry for what I did to you earlier.\nNext time if you see something weird like that\nagain, just stay away from it, okay? Bye bye!
